system.description:
Opal's most aggressive duelling school: attack as defence, momentum as armour. It is taught to the fleet's captains, and Lankhmar's Opal founders carried it there.

  • Reshapes: Relentless Assault.
  • Committed Blade: you gain Relentless Assault at 1st level. It adds 2d4 (3d4 from 9th level).
  • Noble Rivalry: Advantage on Intimidation checks and on checks involving duelling culture and noble rivalries.

features.name: Committed Blade
features.description: You gain Relentless Assault at 1st level. It adds 2d4 (3d4 from 9th level).

activities.name: Relentless Assault
activities.text: Relentless Assault from 1st level: once per round, when you hit a creature you have already hit since the start of your turn, add this in place of its 1d4.

rules.when: Relentless Assault (from 1st level; in place of its 1d4)
